weld.shared_sub_object_S: S = the empirically established two-way electricity<->magnetism COUPLING that BOTH traditions already accepted and re-described in their own idioms: Oersted's current-deflects-compass (1820), Ampere's current-current force (1820s), and above all Faraday's electromagnetic INDUCTION (1831). Faraday rendered this seam as 'lines being cut'; the continentals as flux/force integrals. Maxwell fused along it by writing Faraday's lines IN the continental calculus and closing the induction loop with the displacement current.
weld._shared_sub_object_S_note: S is genuinely shared (both parents describe the SAME coupling phenomena), which is what makes this a pushout and not a pile — the seam pre-exists the weld in both parents' vocabularies. This is the cleanest S in the specimen set: a real, named, experimentally-fixed overlap.
weld.surprise: That LIGHT ITSELF falls out of the merge, at the experimentally measured speed of light — an entire third science (optics) emerging unbidden from a synthesis built only out of electricity and magnetism. Neither parent contains it: Faraday's field ontology had no velocity (his own 1846 light-guess was explicitly speed-less for 'want of data'), and the continental force laws had no light at all. Only after Maxwell adds the DISPLACEMENT CURRENT (in neither parent) do the two field equations close into a self-propagating transverse wave whose speed is the pure-laboratory ratio of electromagnetic to electrostatic units (Weber-Kohlrausch ~3.1x10^8 m/s) — which equalled Fizeau's measured speed of light. A number got by weighing charges and currents on a bench turned out to BE the speed of light. (And latent inside it, unseen by Maxwell, sat the frame-independence of c that would become special relativity.)
weld._surprise_note: Very high confidence the surprise is REAL synergy (not additive): the bench-measured unit-ratio = optical light-speed coincidence is the single most-cited fact in the whole specimen and is the textbook definition of an emergent third reachable only from both parents jointly. BUT the surprise has a PRIORITY complication: Faraday qualitatively conjectured 'light = vibration of lines of force' in 1846, 15 years before Maxwell made it quantitative — so the surprise pre-existed as a low-confidence weld (a conjecture) inside parent W_A. See discrepancy 1 and gaps[4].

dormancy_intervals.why: DORMANCY (A) — the light-as-EM CONJECTURE. Faraday's speculative 1846 'Ray-Vibrations' proposed light is a vibration of the lines of force, but it sat as an unconfirmable speculation (speed-less, 'for want of data') until Maxwell's equations supplied the velocity. A conjecture = a low-confidence weld drawn but not yet confirmed; this is that, sitting dormant inside parent W_A for ~15 years until the OTHER parent (the math) arrived to make it calculable.

DORMANCY (B) — the THEORY ITSELF was semi-dormant / under-received. 'Fertile but half-finished'; the opaque 20-equation quaternion/potential form was hard to use; credible continental rivals (Weber) still in play. Maxwell died 1879 with the theory not yet consolidated or widely accepted.

revival._comment: Two revivals, matching the two dormancies. This single 'revival' slot under-counts — see gaps[0]; the second revival is structurally a SECOND WELD producing a re-attributed child.
revival.by: Revival (A): Maxwell himself. Revival (B): the MAXWELLIANS — Oliver Heaviside (vector recast, potentials eliminated, 1884-85), Heinrich Hertz (independent reformulation + the 1887-88 experimental detection of the waves), George FitzGerald and Oliver Lodge (spread + theoretical strengthening).
revival.trigger: Revival (A): Maxwell spotting the Weber-Kohlrausch unit-ratio (~3.1x10^8 m/s, dated 1855 in Wikipedia) matching Fizeau's measured speed of light (~3.14x10^8 m/s, 1848-49), late 1861 while working on Part III of 'On Physical Lines of Force'. Revival (B): Heaviside's vector reduction made the theory USABLE (4 equations not 20), and the single sharpest trigger was Hertz's 1887-88 experimental generation/detection of the waves, which converted contested math into confirmed physics. Maxwell (d.1879) saw NEITHER revival complete.

discrepancies._comment: Discrepancy 1 — priority on the light claim.
discrepancies.what: PRIORITY / contested-genealogy on the LIGHT claim: Faraday's 1846 'Thoughts on Ray-Vibrations' already proposed that light IS a vibration of the lines of force. Maxwell himself wrote it was 'the same in substance' as his own theory 'except that in 1846 there was no data to calculate the velocity of propagation.' So is the 'light = EM' surprise Maxwell's child or Faraday's? The schema credits the WELD (Faraday had the qualitative guess; only Maxwell's fusion gives the quantitative c), but the priority is genuinely shared and Maxwell graciously conceded it.
sources_in_conflict: the popular 'Maxwell discovered light is EM' narrative
discrepancies._type_enum: one of: priority-dispute | contested-genealogy | date/attribution-conflict | framework-vs-record-tension | dormancy-contested | whig-vs-revisionist
discrepancies.why_interesting: The surprise is OLDER than the weld in QUALITATIVE form — it sat dormant as a speculation in ONE parent for ~15 years until the OTHER parent (the math) arrived to make it calculable. This is exactly the framework's 'conjecture = a low-confidence weld drawn but not yet confirmed' living in the historical record: Faraday DREW the weld; Maxwell CONFIRMED it. Motivates a surprise_priority field (gaps[4]).
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Does NOT lower confidence in the surprise's reality (still 0.96); it RELOCATES part of the credit to parent W_A and time-stamps the conjecture. Raises the value of the specimen as a frontier-in-the-record exemplar.

discrepancies._comment: Discrepancy 2 — THE highest-value one. The second birth + misattribution.
discrepancies.what: FRAMEWORK-VS-RECORD TENSION (highest value): 'Maxwell's equations' as universally taught were NOT written by Maxwell. The clean child W_C had effectively a SECOND birth. Maxwell left 20 coupled equations in 20 variables (potentials/quaternions) in the 1873 Treatise — 'fertile but half-finished.' The compact 4-equation vector field theory was forged 1879-1894 by the MAXWELLIANS: Oliver Heaviside (vector recast, potentials eliminated, ~1884-85), Heinrich Hertz (independent reformulation + the 1887-88 experimental detection of the waves), George FitzGerald and Oliver Lodge. Heaviside's own 1893 line: if Maxwell would have accepted the modifications 'then I think the resulting modified theory may well be called Maxwell's.' The equations were even called Hertz-Heaviside / Maxwell-Hertz before settling on 'Maxwell's.'
sources_in_conflict: IEEE Spectrum 'The Long Road to Maxwell's Equations'
discrepancies.why_interesting: The clean two-parent->one-child diagram HIDES a whole SECOND merge event: the raw W_C (Treatise) was ITSELF a parent that, welded with vector analysis (Gibbs/Heaviside) and experimental confirmation (Hertz), produced the W_C we actually use. The schema's single 'weld' under-counts: there is a BIRTH (Maxwell, 1865) AND a CONSOLIDATION/RESURRECTION (Maxwellians, ~1885) — and the canonical NAME attaches to the WRONG node. This is the missing schema variable: a child can be RE-WELDED and RE-ATTRIBUTED; 'who the child is named after' != 'who produced the surviving structure.' Captured here in the DB's own vocabulary as a dormant-resurrection of the Treatise's tangled form into the clean form (dormancy_intervals[1] + revival B). The load-bearing schema gap (gaps[0]).
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Does not lower confidence in the child's reality, but SPLITS the weld into two events the schema renders as one. The single most important variable-refinement the specimen surfaces.

discrepancies._comment: Discrepancy 3 — contested genealogy of the whole field.
discrepancies.what: CONTESTED GENEALOGY of the whole field: was the real lineage Faraday's FIELD/contiguous-action tradition, or the CONTINENTAL action-at-a-distance tradition (Ampere, Gauss, Weber, Neumann, Riemann, Helmholtz)? Maxwell's synthesis is usually told as the field view's triumph, but its mathematical bones (Ampere's law, induction formalism) are continental, and Weber's electrodynamics was a serious rival theory that ALSO predicted a characteristic velocity. The 'parents' are thus drawn from two WARRING SCHOOLS, and which one is the 'true' parent is a live historiographical choice.
sources_in_conflict: Wikipedia 'History of electromagnetic theory' + Britannica + Hunt
vs Whewell/older Whig 'Faraday->Maxwell straight line' accounts
discrepancies.why_interesting: Directly the framework's 'what were the real parents?' problem (the brief's special-relativity Einstein-vs-Lorentz-Poincare analogue). The weld SUCCEEDED partly by LAUNDERING continental math into a field ontology — the winning child kept W_A's ONTOLOGY but W_B's CALCULUS, so each losing parent can claim half of it. Frame-relative: in the {knowledge} frame the continental math is a parent; in the {space}/ontology frame Faraday's field is the parent. The two-parent split {Faraday-field, continental-math} is itself the resolution of this dispute, not a neutral given.
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Keeps both parents at high confidence but flags that their RELATIVE weight is frame-dependent and contested; the 0.95/0.9 split is a defensible projection, not a fact.

Maxwell's recognition of the c-coincidence is variously dated to late 1861 / 1862. Also the paper-date spread: 'On Faraday's Lines of Force' 1855-56; 'On Physical Lines of Force' 1861-62; 'A Dynamical Theory of the Electromagnetic Field' read 1864, published 1865 (often cited as either).
sources_in_conflict: Royal Society commentary vs Wikipedia on Maxwell's 1861 vs 1862 realization

discrepancies.what: MULTI-PARENT reality vs the schema's 2-parent weld (SCHEMA.md flag 6 instantiated): the honest parent set is at LEAST seven — Coulomb (electrostatics), Oersted (current->magnetism), Ampere (force law), Faraday (induction + field ontology), Gauss (flux laws), Neumann/Weber (induction formalism), William Thomson/Kelvin (the mechanical-analogy METHOD Maxwell borrowed). Collapsing to {Faraday-field, continental-math} is a defensible but lossy 2-projection.
sources_in_conflict: vs the framework's binary W_A/W_B visualization
discrepancies.why_interesting: This is the canonical clean-two-vs-messy-many tension the brief most wants flagged. The 2-parent render is a deliberate DIMENSIONALITY REDUCTION; the residue (Thomson's analogy method, Oersted's founding observation) is exactly the 'which variables is the schema missing' signal. Notably Thomson is a parent of the METHOD, not of the content, and Fizeau supplied the calibration TARGET, not content — the schema has no slot for a 'methodological parent' or an 'instrument parent' distinct from a 'content parent' (gaps[1]), and no n-ary parents_full[] (gaps[2]).
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Does not change the child confidence; flags that parents[] length-2 is a lossy projection here and motivates both a parent_kind tag and an optional n-ary parents_full[].

discrepancies._comment: Discrepancy 6 — frame-relativity of the weld (textbook confirmation of the brief thesis).
discrepancies.what: Whether the WELD's frame even produces a third in SPACE alone: two static facts ('electricity exists', 'magnetism exists') side by side in the SPACE frame make NOTHING; it is only through TIME (CHANGING fields — induction + displacement current, i.e. d/dt) that the third (self-propagating wave) appears. The unification is intrinsically a TIME-frame weld.
sources_in_conflict: vs a naive static reading of 'unifying two forces'
discrepancies.why_interesting: A TEXTBOOK confirmation of the brief's frame-relativity thesis ('two rocks in SPACE = nothing; two rocks through TIME = strata'). Electricity+magnetism in the {space} frame = two adjacent phenomena; in the {time} frame = one self-propagating field. frame_of_weld is therefore {time} essentially, even though the child W_C is read in {space,knowledge,meaning}. The displacement current is LITERALLY a time-derivative term — the weld is welded BY time. This makes Maxwell's EM a clean positive analogue to the rocks-in-time case in parents_produce_WC_FORMALIZATION_DRAFT §2 (case 10). Motivates a weld_operator note-field (gaps[3]).
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Strengthens the render: confirms frame_of_weld=[time] is correct and that the frame thesis discriminates correctly on a settled top-tier case. Raises confidence the schema's frame machinery is right.
